'''Csillian flu''' was an infectious flu that was known in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Several [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] caught the Csillian flu.
